The archive's flag that a source changed on 18 Oct 2026 does not concern this instrument: that day the archiver stored, in the record's document-2 slot, a different PDF linked from the page (r05/jisyuhoan_shiryo_01.pdf, a summary of a survey on non-explosion-proof equipment in plants), not a new version of the revision summary. judgment.status_reasoning: The council's page (copy of 14 Oct 2026, unchanged on 18 Oct 2026) still lists the second edition of March 2021 as the current guideline, with its English edition, practical examples and Q&A; no later edition or withdrawal appears. The guidelines set out a methodology that plant owners and AI vendors can use and are to be reviewed continuously as they are used, so they are non-binding. 'Published (non-binding, current)' stands.
judgment.date_reasoning: date_published 2020-11 is the first edition (2020年11月 on the page; 令和2年11月の公表 in the revision summary), given to the month as the official sources give it. date_last_updated 2021-03 is the second edition (2021 年 3 月 on the Japanese cover; 2021年3月改訂; 'March 2021').
judgment.scope_reasoning: Government guidelines on assessing the reliability of machine learning in safety-critical plants; in scope with no note.
